headline: Indian stock markets extend winning streak on foreign fund inflows and gains in financials and realty stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Optimism surrounding foreign institutional fund inflows supported market momentum.
Financial, banking, and realty stocks led gains across recent trading sessions.
Positive corporate earnings and acquisition developments boosted individual stock performance.
Asian markets showed resilience despite turmoil in global technology stocks and Wall Street losses.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty extended their winning streak to a third consecutive day, holding above key levels.
NHC Foods reported a 16-fold jump in Q2 net profit alongside its acquisition of Sachmaas.
HEG Advanced Material signed a major EV MoU, while Roto Pumps surged 14%.
Brent crude oil prices climbed back above $95 per barrel, reversing recent course.
summary:
Indian equities extended their winning streak supported by strong foreign fund inflows and robust performance in banking, financials, and realty sectors.
Key market indices stayed firm, with Nifty trading comfortably above 25,200 as smallcap stocks continued to outperform.
Corporate news flow highlighted strong Q2 earnings, strategic acquisitions, and EV-focused expansion initiatives across specific companies.
